req.title: Login rejects wrong username
req.statement: The system shall render an 'Incorrect username.' error when the supplied username is not found.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-009 requires that POST /auth/login renders 'Incorrect username.' when the supplied username does not exist. Violations to fix: test[0] had kind=negative but heuristic=EP — EP (Equivalence Partitioning) is a partitioning heuristic that applies to both positive and negative partitions, but the rule requires negative kind to use NEG, BVA, STC, or DT — so test[0] heuristic is changed from EP to NEG (it tests the invalid equivalence class of non-existent usernames, which maps to NEG). test[4] had kind=negative but heuristic=STC — STC (State Transition Coverage) is only valid for positive kind per the rule-based verifier — so test[4] heuristic is changed from STC to NEG (it still tests the state-transition logic but is classified under NEG). All other tests are preserved exactly as they passed verification.

tests.name: test_login_wrong_username_shows_incorrect_username_error
preconditions: Database is initialised with fixture data (users: test/test, other/other)
Username 'nonexistent_user' does not exist in the database
trace: R-FLASKR-009: system shall render 'Incorrect username.' when username not found
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'nonexistent_user', 'password': 'anypassword'})
assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
assert b'Incorrect username.' in r.data, 'Expected Incorrect username. in response'
assert b'Incorrect password.' not in r.data, 'Did not expect Incorrect password. in response'

tests.name: test_login_wrong_username_does_not_redirect
preconditions: Database is initialised with fixture data
trace: R-FLASKR-009: failed login must stay on login page (200), not transition to authenticated state (302 to index); wrong username must not cause redirect
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'ghost', 'password': 'ghost'})
assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
assert r.status_code != 302, 'Must not redirect on wrong username'
assert b'Incorrect username.' in r.data, 'Expected Incorrect username. in response'
location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
assert location != '/', f'Location must not be / on failed login, got {location}'
